// Scripts/World/Phases/RadioBeacon.cs  (modelo — Fase 3, Bananal)
// "Radar sonoro": perto da antena a 96.6 toca limpa; longe, a música some e o chiado cresce.
// Coloque na antena/repetidora. Os dois players são filhos dela (ou de quem preferir) e tocam em loop.
using Godot;

namespace DeadFrequency;

public partial class RadioBeacon : Node3D
{
    [Export] public Node3D Player;                 // o PlayerController (ou a câmera) da fase
    [Export] public AudioStreamPlayer MusicPlayer; // bus AudioManager.MusicBus
    [Export] public AudioStreamPlayer StaticPlayer; // chiado, bus AudioManager.SfxBus
    [Export] public float MaxSignalDistance = 120f;
    [Export] public float ClearSignalDistance = 15f;

    public override void _Process(double delta)
    {
        if (Player == null || MusicPlayer == null || StaticPlayer == null)
            return;
        float dist = GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(Player.GlobalPosition);
        float t = Mathf.Clamp((dist - ClearSignalDistance) / (MaxSignalDistance - ClearSignalDistance), 0f, 1f);
        MusicPlayer.VolumeDb = Mathf.Lerp(0f, -45f, t);
        StaticPlayer.VolumeDb = Mathf.Lerp(-35f, -4f, t);
    }
}
